diagnosis: MultiLangPolicyDetailView uses hvad's TranslatableManager method .language('all') to retrieve policies in any available language. By chaining .language('all').get(pk=policy_id) without filtering by request.user.company, the view circumvents tenant boundaries. Any authenticated user can supply arbitrary policy IDs to extract confidential insurance and compliance policy agreements belonging to other corporate clients.
